## Installation

```sh
pip install config-only
```

Or with [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/):

```sh
uv tool install config-only
```

## Usage

Install it, run `config-only --help`, and that is genuinely all there is.

> [!NOTE]
> This README was produced from `readme.yaml` alone; no Jinja lives in this directory.
